metadata.purpose: Parameters and literature anchors for the Pass 3 full 3D triangulated vertex-shell extension of 2019-trushko-epithelioid-cyst-buckling.py (closes Pass 2 remediation item: 'Extend the 2D equatorial Foppl-von Karman ring solver to a full 3D triangulated vertex shell with apical-basal differential tension').

primary_sources.use: Post-confluence pressure P(t) and fold-depth delta(t)/R_0 trajectories (Fig. 2E, transcribed in epithelioid_cyst_buckling_reference.json) and single-fold observation (Fig. 2, n = 1 in ~75% of standard capsules).
Spontaneous curvature of a polarized monolayer set by the apical-basal tension difference: minimiser of f(H) = (kappa/2)(2H)^2 - dGamma h (2H) is 2H_0 = dGamma h / kappa (Eqs. 1-3).
Helfrich spontaneous-curvature bending energy (kappa/2)(2H - 2H_0)^2 used as the discrete per-vertex bending term.
Triangular spring-network mapping k_s = sqrt(3)/2 * Y_2D for the 2D Young modulus of the discretised membrane and discrete bending energy on triangulated surfaces.
Alginate microcapsule radial stiffness (Winkler foundation K_alg) from the capsule wall thickness H_alg and E_alg.

notes: The 3D shell is a reduced-but-honest model: a closed icosphere (642 vertices, 1280 triangles) with harmonic edge springs (rest length grown by g), a discrete Helfrich bending energy with spontaneous curvature along the radial (apical-basal) axis, a unilateral Winkler capsule wall, and a short-range self-contact penalty at the monolayer thickness h.

delta_gamma_wt_mN_per_m is a CALIBRATED constant, not a measured value: it is chosen so that the spontaneous curvature equals the confluent-sphere curvature, H_0 R_0 = 6 (1 - nu^2) dGamma R_0 / (E_epi h^2) = 1 (nu = 0.45) for the standard WT capsule (R_0 = 100 um, h = 10.5 um, E_epi = 18.5 kPa). Hannezo et al. (2014) argue that a free cyst adopts the radius set by this spontaneous curvature; direct apical/basal tension measurements for MDCK-in-capsule are not reported by Trushko et al. (2020).

The dGamma sweep spans basal-dominant (negative), apolar (0) and apical-dominant (positive) tension differences; Blebbistatin is modelled as Gamma_myo = 0.15 multiplying dGamma (reduced actomyosin-driven polarity) in addition to the reduced E_epi used by the 2D ring.

shell3d_model.curvature_discretisation: umbrella operator with lagged per-step normalisation m_v = mean(l_u^2)/4: 2H_v ~ -(n_v . L x)_v / m_v; bending weight (kappa/2) A_v g^2 / m_v^2

apicobasal_tension.spontaneous_curvature_formula: H_0 R_0 = 6 * (1 - nu^2) * dGamma * R_0 / (E_epi * h^2)   (2H_0 = dGamma h / kappa, kappa = E_epi h^3 / (12 (1 - nu^2)))
apicobasal_tension.expected_fold_count_source: Trushko et al. (2020) Dev. Cell Fig. 2: single inward fold in standard R_0 = 100 um, E_alg = 5 kPa capsules

wall_pressure_comparison.description: Capsule pressure inferred from the 3D shell as P_3D(g) = K_alg * (r_wall / R_0 - 1) is compared with the transcribed standard_P_kPa trajectory of epithelioid_cyst_buckling_reference.json (Trushko et al. 2020 Fig. 2E, pressure read from alginate capsule dilation).
